```yaml
package_name: macports

    name: install_command
    value: "xcode-select --install"

  - category: dependency
    name: optional_packages
    value:
      - "Apple Xcode Developer Tools"

  - category: dependency
    name: xcode_versions
    value:
      darwin_tahoe: "26.0 or later"

      darwin_snow_leopard: "3.2 or later"

    name: pkg_installers
    value:
      - "MacPorts-2.11.6-26-Tahoe.pkg"

    name: source_download
    value:
      - "MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.bz2"
      - "MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.gz"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Installing MacPorts section"

  - category: installation
    name: source_install_commands
    value:
      - "tar xjvf MacPorts-2.11.6.tar.bz2"
      - "cd MacPorts-2.11.6"
      - "./configure && make && sudo make install"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Source Installation section"

  - category: installation
    name: git_repository
    value: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base.git"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "guide.macports.org - Git Install section"

  - category: installation
    name: checksums_file
    value: "https://github.com/macports/macports-base/releases/download/v2.11.6/MacPorts-2.11.6.chk.txt"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Installing MacPorts section"

    name: shell_environment_setup
    value:
      - "Add ${prefix}/bin and ${prefix}/sbin to the start of PATH"
      - "Add ${prefix}/share/man to MANPATH if needed"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Source Installation section"
    annotation: "Required for source installation, automatic for pkg installer"

  - category: configuration
    name: xcode_license_acceptance
    value: "xcodebuild -license"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: darwin
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Requirements section"
    annotation: "Required for Xcode 4 and later users"

  - category: configuration
    name: selfupdate_command
    value: "sudo port -v selfupdate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer section"

  - category: verification
    name: verify_command
    value: "port version"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "guide.macports.org - macOS Package Install section"

    name: expected_output
    value: "Version: 2.11.6"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "guide.macports.org - macOS Package Install section"

  - category: verification
    name: help_command
    value: "man port"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer section"

    name: migration_support
    value: "port migrate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration - Migration procedure section"

  - category: feature
    name: upgrade_method
    value: "sudo port selfupdate"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Selfupdate section"
    annotation: "Uses rsync networking protocol (tcp port 873)"

  - category: setting
    name: default_prefix
    value: "/opt/local"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "guide.macports.org - Source Install section"

  - category: setting
    name: config_file
    value: "/opt/local/etc/macports/macports.conf"
    confidence: 1.0
    platform: all
    source_ref: "trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration - Review macports.conf settings"

sources:
  - title: "macports.org/install.php"
    url: "https://www.macports.org/install.php"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "Quickstart"
      - "Installing MacPorts"
      - "macOS Package (.pkg) Installer"
      - "Source Installation"
      - "Requirements"

  - title: "trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "Migration procedure"
      - "Review macports.conf settings"

  - title: "guide.macports.org"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "macOS Package Install"
      - "Source Install"
      - "Git Install"

ambiguities:
  - slot_name: "x11_requirement"
    description: "X11 windowing environment is optional but multiple choices available"
    options:
      - "Install xorg-server port from MacPorts (recommended)"
      - "Use XQuartz Project X11 release"
      - "Use Apple's X11.app (older OS versions)"
    suggested_default: "xorg-server port from MacPorts"

tribal_knowledge:
  - title: "Xcode License Must Be Accepted"
    description: "With Xcode 4 and later, users need to accept the Xcode EULA by either launching Xcode or running xcodebuild -license"
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Requirements section"
    affects_phase: "prepare"

  - title: "Command Line Tools Are Critical"
    description: "Apple's Command Line Developer Tools are required and must be installed via xcode-select --install. Some ports require full Xcode but most only need CLT"
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Requirements section"
    affects_phase: "prepare"

  - title: "Migration Required for Major OS Upgrades"
    description: "A MacPorts installation is designed to work with a particular operating system and hardware architecture. Migration procedure ensures smooth transition after major system changes"
    source_ref: "trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration"
    affects_phase: "install"

  - title: "Shell Environment Setup Is Automatic for PKG"
    description: "The pkg installer automatically adapts shell configuration files but you may need to open a new shell for changes to take effect. Source installs require manual environment setup"
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer section"
    affects_phase: "provision"

  - title: "Regular Updates Are Essential"
    description: "The selfupdate command should be run manually on a regular basis to keep your MacPorts system current with latest available release and Portfiles revisions"
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - macOS Package (.pkg) Installer section"
    affects_phase: "verify"

  - title: "Architecture Settings May Need Updates"
    description: "If macports.conf contains settings for universal_archs or build_arch, you may need to update them when upgrading OS versions as newer OS versions may support different CPU architectures"
    source_ref: "trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration - Review macports.conf settings"
    affects_phase: "provision"
```
